issues.description: The problem statement's UML and description specify numberOfTutors as an int, but the Solution implementation declares numberOfTutors as a short and provides a setter that takes a short. This discrepancy can confuse students about the intended type and may cause mismatches with expected constructor/setter signatures in tests or in student implementations that follow the UML.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the type of numberOfTutors consistent across artifacts. Either (A) change the Solution implementation to declare numberOfTutors as an int and update the constructor and setter to use int, matching the UML/problem statement; or (B) update the problem statement UML and any tests to specify short for numberOfTutors if using a smaller numeric type is intentional. Prefer option (A) to avoid unnecessary use of short and to match the UML.
